finding: The TP2 rank-local bulk prefill installs only resident_prefill_dispatch_session, while the single-card bulk prefill wraps its pass in five further calibrated dispatch contexts. Without them the largest GEMMs on the TP2 attention path resolve to a decode-shaped GEMV kernel during prefill.
reference: hipengine/runtime/qwen35_gguf_runner.py, the run_bulk branch of the resident session

calibration_state.note: every shape above is admitted at exactly rows=512, so the route is available, not merely registrable

achieved_efficiency.method: FLOPs from the GGUF tensor shapes x 512 rows / the attribution's per-layer spans

ab_measurement.protocol: one session, contexts entered per rank inside the per-device loop around that rank's attention call, arms interleaved, 3 prefills per arm, median reported
ab_measurement.command: python /tmp/probe7.py  (harness reproduced in the worklog entry)

independent_repeats.note: four separate A/B/A runs agreed: +3.63/+3.71, +3.67/+3.73, and the interleaved run above

ab_measurement.conclusion: the win is entirely the calibrated f16-rocBLAS prefill route
ab_measurement.not_claimed: The per-tensor variant diff under the context was not captured cleanly (the cache-clearing in that capture was invalid, so it reported 56 tensors for the baseline and 280 for the arm). The routing change is therefore established by the timing A/B and the admitted-policy lookup, not by a variant census.

why_not_integrated: the contexts are methods on Qwen35GGUFResidentSession, not on the runner the TP2 session holds
they carry per-rank scratch (the f16 weight plane and q6_f16_x/q6_f16_out)
entering one rank's context around both ranks' work faults the GPU: measured 'Memory access fault by GPU node-2 ... Page not present or supervisor privilege'
a Qwen35GGUFResidentSession(shared_runner=runner) per rank works and reuses the uploaded weights, but allocates its own bulk-prefill workspace on top of the TP2 session's
the route changes attention arithmetic from int8 WMMA to source-F16 rocBLAS, so it needs the applicable production-profile gate and a registered strict fallback

control_measurement_pcie_floor.method: timed hipMemcpy D2H/H2D of 5.24 MB (the MLP partial size) on both devices, 20 reps, median
control_measurement_pcie_floor.reading: the exchange's two 5.24 MB transfers cost ~0.75 ms of a 0.926 ms span, so the exchange is at ~81% of the measured hardware floor and is not the lever

critical_path_model.method: per-layer, per-rank spans from the corrected attribution, one repetition read whole
critical_path_model.model: rank1_exchange = (rank0 attention+chain - rank1 attention+chain) + rank0 exchange work
critical_path_model.reading: every layer synchronises at its MLP exchange and rank 0 is the critical path; rank 1 idles ~0.75 ms/layer

host_vs_device.reading: the prefill is device-bound; the host has ~7x headroom

instrumentation_overhead.reading: within noise, so the recorded wall is usable
